facts.text: RemoteFluorescenceMicroscope is the FM API over devices served by fibsem.server.devices on the FM's computer, and connect(host, port) builds it from those devices
connect raises RemoteDeviceUnreachable when the server is not running, unless offline: then the FM is built offline and comes online when the server starts
An FM is made of the fm group and the camera, light_source, filter_set and objective devices
connect refuses an FM whose device server serves no FM devices
is_streaming is true for the live stream, and is_acquiring is true for the live stream or a claimed operation
is_interactive is true while idle and while streaming, and false while another operation drives the FM
set_channel_name and set_channel_color store the session's channel label
set_binning, set_exposure_time and set_gain write the camera's binning, exposure time and gain parameters
The camera exposure time is in seconds
start_acquisition marks the FM streaming and starts a daemon thread for continuous live acquisition
stop_acquisition signals the acquisition thread, waits up to 2 seconds for it, and stops emitting new images

measures.description: True while the live stream or a claimed operation drives the fluorescence microscope
measures.name: is_acquiring

measures.description: True while the user may drive the hardware (idle or streaming)
measures.name: is_interactive

measures.description: What is driving the fluorescence microscope, or empty when it is idle
measures.name: acquiring_reason

operator_required.name: exposure_time
operator_required.reason: the exposure range is reported by the installed camera at runtime and no text file of the clone states a fixed range; the site sets the operating range of its camera

operator_required.name: binning
operator_required.reason: the available binning factors depend on the installed camera and are read from it at runtime, so no text file of the clone fixes them; the site sets the allowed factors

operator_required.name: gain
operator_required.reason: the gain range is reported by the installed camera at runtime and no text file of the clone states a fixed range; the site sets the operating range

safe_state.description: live acquisition stopped: the acquisition thread is signalled and no further frames are emitted
